inertia_kgm2.formula: diagonal of the combined tensor about the CG; parallel axis; shapes: box, cylinder (motor), thin disc (prop), thin rod (arm)

mass_kg.formula: sum of part mass_kg (with cables) x counts

max_rpm.formula: full-throttle motor/prop torque balance at nominal pack voltage 22.200 V; design-time estimate (tools/parts/estimates.py); P3's electrical model supersedes it

motor_pos_m.formula: (+-s/2, +-s/2) from motor_spacing_adjacent_m; z = propeller plane z minus CG z; order FR, FL, RR, RL

motor_spin.formula: same convention as the shipped vehicle_config.json (open point B-3 TODO(HUMAN-VERIFY))

thrust_coeff.formula: static Ct fit, SCALED_FROM:apc_12x6e, file offline_pipeline/props/apce_12x6.json, band [3000.0, 4500.0] rpm

estimates.note: design-time estimate (tools/parts/estimates.py); P3's electrical model supersedes it

inertia_cross_check_old_lumped.old_method: point masses at motors + remaining mass as one central box (build_ref_config.py)

mass_properties.core_limitation: the core takes only the diagonal; the off-diagonal products above are dropped

powertrain.parameters_verified_rule: 1 only if no part input and no builder constant is ASSUMED

propeller_table.method: runs within 2 % of rpm merged with a linear blend over the J overlap; static Ct/Cp added as the J = 0 point; nominal rpm from the file names
propeller_table.note: the core uses the table; estimates.py (max_rpm, hover point) still use the static constants, so hover thrust and duty in the core differ slightly

projected_areas_m2.note: frame record areas + bounding-box faces of motors, battery and other parts; props excluded; overlap ignored (conservative)
